description: This file defines the Application class, a cross-platform application framework for managing application lifecycle, event handling, and state transitions within the Starboard environment. It includes methods for controlling application states, event scheduling, and handling media frames, along with lifecycle hooks for subclasses.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: A framework class for managing application lifecycle, event dispatching, and state transitions in a cross-platform environment.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the application event loop, dispatching initialization and teardown events, and blocks until exit.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Application class.

methods.name: Blur
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from STARTED to BLURRED state.

methods.name: Focus
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from BLURRED to STARTED state.

methods.name: Conceal
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from STARTED or BLURRED to CONCEALED.

methods.name: Reveal
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from CONCEALED to STARTED.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from STARTED or BLURRED to FROZEN.

methods.name: Unfreeze
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from FROZEN to CONCEALED.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the application, transitioning through states to STOPPED.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Injects a link event with specified link data.

methods.name: InjectLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Injects a low memory event into the application.

methods.name: WindowSizeChanged
methods.description: Injects a window size change event.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an event to occur after a specified delay.

methods.name: HandleFrame
methods.description: Handles a new video frame received from the media system.

methods.name: RegisterTeardownCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called during application teardown.
